segment.description: Divide the video into smaller segments by identifying changes in topic, scene, or operation step - using visual or audio cues, dialogue shifts, or transitions as indicators. If the video centers on a single main topic, segment it further by breaking out distinct subtopics. Avoid returning a single segment for the entire video.
